columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Planner-visible context is not an authorization boundary when authority lives across substrates
columns.title_zh: 当 Authority 跨 Substrate 存在时，Planner 可见上下文不是授权边界
columns.source_zh: Cross-substrate Authority 一手受控研究：缺失 Authority Fact 的证据解释失败，而即便 Planner 获得完整 Authority Relation，安全关键效果仍需 Mutation Boundary 上的确定性 Guard
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260912-004 after Skill 02 triage. The signal supplies unusually direct counterfactual evidence for a Digital Employee governance question: the same apparent workspace/action context can have different safety meaning when decision-relevant authority lives in an external receipt or other substrate. Authority-blind evidence produced 0/32 final semantic success while raw receipts or an equivalent typed relation produced 32/32 in the evidence-ablation experiment, yet planner reliability remained imperfect even when the relation was present. A deterministic execution guard then blocked all six unsafe fixed intents while allowing all twelve valid authorized publish intents. The bounded research question is therefore not merely how to give the model better memory, but which authority evidence must be carried into reasoning and which decision must remain enforced outside the planner at the actual mutation boundary. This differs from the September 11 memory-evidence object: that object governed preservation of atomic observations while semantic memory roles change; today's object tests authority that can live outside model-visible memory entirely and asks why evidence completeness still does not eliminate the need for an execution guard. SIG-20260912-005 is retained as an important comparison on stateful delegation and scope attenuation, but selecting both as separate Daily objects would create semantic concentration around authorization and delegation in the same column.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260912-004。该 Signal 为数字员工治理提供了很少见的直接反事实证据：当决定安全性的 Authority 存在于外部 Receipt 或其他 Substrate 时，看起来相同的 Workspace / Action Context 可以具有不同的安全含义。在 Evidence Ablation 中，缺失 Authority Fact 的证据最终语义成功为 0/32，而 Raw Receipt 或等价 Typed Relation 均为 32/32；但即使 Relation 已提供，Planner 可靠性仍不充分。随后，确定性 Execution Guard 对固定 Intent 重放时阻止全部 6 个不安全 Intent，并允许全部 12 个有效授权 Publish Intent。因此有界研究问题不只是“怎样给模型更好的 Memory”，而是：哪些 Authority Evidence 必须进入推理，哪些裁决仍必须留在 Planner 之外、由真正 Mutation Boundary 的确定性 Guard 执行。它与 9 月 11 日 Memory Evidence 对象实质不同：昨天研究的是语义 Memory Role 变化时如何保留 Atomic Observation；今天研究的是 Authority 可以完全存在于 Model-visible Memory 之外，并追问为什么证据完整仍不能替代执行边界。SIG-20260912-005 作为 Stateful Delegation 与 Scope Attenuation 的重要比较证据保留，但若两者都独立选为 Daily Object，会造成同一栏目的 Authorization / Delegation 语义集中。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the paper's exact evidence-ablation design, raw-receipt versus typed-relation information equivalence, all 32-trial semantic-success counts, planner-model/task setup, the fixed-intent replay protocol, six unsafe and twelve authorized publish cases, execution-guard predicates, whether the guard observes complete authority state, failure cases that remain after evidence completion, and limits on generalizing a controlled publication workflow to arbitrary tools, organizations or multi-agent delegation. It should also read SIG-20260912-005 as comparison evidence without turning it into a second selected object.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验论文的精确 Evidence Ablation 设计、Raw Receipt 与 Typed Relation 的信息等价性、全部 32 次实验的 Semantic Success 计数、Planner Model / Task Setup、Fixed-intent Replay Protocol、6 个不安全与 12 个有效授权 Publish Case、Execution Guard Predicate、Guard 是否能完整观察 Authority State、Evidence Completion 后仍存在的 Failure Case，以及把受控 Publication Workflow 推广到任意 Tool、Organization 或 Multi-Agent Delegation 时的边界；同时将 SIG-20260912-005 作为比较证据读取，但不得把它变成第二个已选对象。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Long-lived agent systems need explicit authority precedence when current policy conflicts with retained session state
columns.title_zh: 当当前 Policy 与既有 Session State 冲突时，长生命周期 Agent 需要显式 Authority Precedence
columns.source_zh: 跨样本工程机制比较：Codex 在动作边界用当前 Managed Provider Requirement 重新校验既有 Thread Route；MCP 在 Provider Token 存在后让 Transport 派生 Authorization 覆盖陈旧 Caller Authorization；Gemini CLI 则把 Credential / Trust / Policy-integrity 状态隔离在 Sandbox Workspace 之外
columns.reason: Selected as a cross-sample Industry Architecture object centered on SIG-20260912-001 and independently supported by SIG-20260912-003, with SIG-20260912-002 as an adjacent control-state isolation contrast. The common architecture problem is authority precedence in a long-lived system: retained thread routes, caller-supplied headers or workspace-visible files can remain internally valid while current managed policy or runtime-authenticated identity changes. Codex now revalidates retained provider routes against current managed requirements before model-driving or state-changing operations and rejects mismatch/load failure without mutating queue/goal state while preserving safe stop controls. The MCP TypeScript SDK independently implements the same precedence principle at the transport boundary: once authProvider has a token, transport-derived Authorization deterministically replaces stale caller Authorization rather than coexisting or concatenating. Gemini CLI adds a related isolation mechanism by denying sandbox access to credentials, trust databases and policy-integrity state. The bounded architecture question is which authority source should win at action time, how current authoritative state is identified, and how rejection preserves safe control paths without granting stale session state continued power. This is not a claim that these three implementations prove one universal design; their different boundaries make the comparison useful precisely because the shared principle must be separated from product-specific mechanisms.
columns.reason_zh: 作为跨样本 Industry Architecture 对象选入，以 SIG-20260912-001 为中心、SIG-20260912-003 提供独立支持，并把 SIG-20260912-002 作为相邻的 Control-state Isolation 对照。共同架构问题是长生命周期系统中的 Authority Precedence：保留下来的 Thread Route、Caller-supplied Header 或 Workspace-visible File 可以在自身内部仍然“有效”，但当前 Managed Policy 或 Runtime-authenticated Identity 已经改变。Codex 现在会在驱动模型或改变状态的操作前，用当前 Managed Requirement 重新校验既有 Provider Route；Mismatch 或 Requirement Load Failure 时拒绝请求且不修改 Queue / Goal State，同时保留安全的 Stop Control。MCP TypeScript SDK 在独立 Transport Boundary 上实现相同的优先级原则：一旦 authProvider 已有 Token，Transport 派生的 Authorization 会确定性替换陈旧 Caller Authorization，而不是共存或拼接。Gemini CLI 则提供相邻的隔离机制，禁止 Sandbox 访问 Credential、Trust Database 与 Policy-integrity State。有界架构问题因此是：动作发生时哪一个 Authority Source 应当胜出，系统怎样识别“当前权威状态”，以及拒绝路径怎样保留安全控制能力而不让陈旧 Session State 继续拥有执行权。这并不是宣称三个实现已经证明一个普适设计；恰恰因为它们位于不同边界，才适合用比较来区分共享原则与产品特定机制。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must inspect the exact Codex call sites and non-mutation behavior on requirement mismatch/load failure; the MCP header construction order, case-insensitive overwrite logic, provider-token transition and fallback behavior before a provider token exists; and Gemini CLI's sandbox profile rules separating workspace effects from credentials/trust/policy-integrity state. It must compare which state is authoritative, when it is refreshed, what operations are blocked, which stop/recovery controls remain available, and where the three implementations are not equivalent. It must not infer general validity from merged implementation status alone.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需检查 Codex 的精确 Call Site 以及 Requirement Mismatch / Load Failure 时不修改状态的行为；MCP 的 Header Construction Order、大小写不敏感覆盖逻辑、Provider Token Transition，以及 Provider 尚无 Token 前的 Fallback Behavior；还需检查 Gemini CLI 的 Sandbox Profile 如何把 Workspace Effect 与 Credential / Trust / Policy-integrity State 分开。必须比较各系统中哪类 State 是 Authority、何时刷新、哪些 Operation 被阻止、哪些 Stop / Recovery Control 仍可使用，以及三个实现在哪些地方并不等价；不得仅因代码已 Merge 就推导普适有效性。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260912-002 is concrete merged evidence for sandbox/runtime-state isolation, but selecting it separately would substantially duplicate the authority-precedence/control-state boundary already selected for Industry Architecture and would create semantic concentration. SIG-20260912-003 is likewise consumed as independent comparison evidence inside Q-20260912-02 rather than promoted as a second near-identical Daily object. No other same-day Open-source Engineering signal provides a sufficiently distinct, evidence-supported bounded question after deduplication. The column is explicitly closed with No Selection rather than filling a quota.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260912-002 是具体的 Merged Evidence，揭示 Sandbox / Runtime-state Isolation，但若单独选入，会与 Industry Architecture 已选的 Authority Precedence / Control-state Boundary 高度重复并造成语义集中。SIG-20260912-003 同样作为 Q-20260912-02 内部的独立比较证据使用，而不是提升为第二个近似 Daily Object。其余当天 Open-source Engineering Signal 在去重后没有形成一个足够不同且证据充分的有界问题，因此本栏显式以 No Selection 收口，而不是为了填满名额而强选。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260912-002 and SIG-20260912-003 as reusable engineering evidence for Q-20260912-02 and future cross-sample studies. Reading must perform no separate Open-source Engineering object for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260912-002 与 SIG-20260912-003，作为 Q-20260912-02 及未来跨样本研究可复用的工程证据；本轮 Reading 不得为 Open-source Engineering 创建独立对象。
